name: @tierfog/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for Tierfog (common + identity + product domains)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.json && redocly bundle sites --output src/.bundled/sites.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle sites --output src/.bundled/sites.json && redocly bundle tiers --output src/.bundled/tiers.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle tiers --output src/.bundled/tiers.json && redocly bundle protocol --output src/.bundled/protocol.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle protocol --output src/.bundled/protocol.json && redocly bundle jobs --output src/.bundled/jobs.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle jobs --output src/.bundled/jobs.json && redocly bundle fl --output src/.bundled/fl.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle fl --output src/.bundled/fl.json && redocly bundle addressing --output src/.bundled/addressing.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle addressing --output src/.bundled/addressing.json && redocly bundle trust --output src/.bundled/trust.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle trust --output src/.bundled/trust.json && redocly bundle provenance --output src/.bundled/provenance.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle provenance --output src/.bundled/provenance.json
